$sources: The species: Taxus baccata L., yew: an evergreen tree or shrub, the needles linear, 1-3 cm by 2-3 mm, dark green above, paler beneath, spirally set but spreading in two ranks on the side shoots; clipped, it forms a dense hedge (C. Stace, New Flora of the British Isles, 4th ed., Cambridge 2019, Taxaceae).

The clipped hedge: the as-built museum's yew hedges (windows/Source/MuseeVision/Nature/MuseeHedge.cpp, NarrowYewRun): needles 1.6-2.6 cm, 30 000 to a square metre of clipped surface, the season's new growth paler at the skin, a dark core of bare twigs.
name: Taxus baccata
note: Clipped to the section its bed gives; its core, the bare twigs inside, takes living.stem. The museum shows it in early summer, Mangzhong to Xiazhi (June).
